standard.name: Deterministic cohort missingness with locally estimable rank-two factors
Consistency for observed untreated potential outcomes

novel.justification: The shell indexes empirically visible alignment strength rather than an oracle factor norm. It is realized by smooth factor-row paths, including the four-mask slope path \(z=19/5+\eta\), while local signal eigenvalues and cohort moment radii remain fixed.

definitions.name: rank-two short-panel law class
definitions.construction: \(\mathcal M=\{P=P^{(N)}:3\le T<\infty,\ 1\le C<\infty,\ |S_c|\ge3,\ O_1,\ldots,O_N\stackrel{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}P_O,\ O_i=(C_i,J_{C_i}Y_i(0)),\ Y_i(0)=\Gamma\lambda_i+\varepsilon_i,\ \operatorname{rank}(\Gamma)=2,\ \Gamma^{\prime}\Gamma=I_2,\ \min_cp_c\ge p_{\star},\ v_{\star}I_2\preceq H_c\preceq v^{\star}I_2,\ \mathbb E_P[\varepsilon_i\mid C_i=c]=0,\ \operatorname{Cov}_P(\lambda_i,\varepsilon_i\mid C_i=c)=0,\ \operatorname{Cov}_P(\varepsilon_i\mid C_i=c)=\sigma_c^2I_T,\ \lambda_2(\Gamma_{S_c}H_c\Gamma_{S_c}^{\prime})\ge g_{\star},\ \max_c\mathbb E_P[\|\lambda_i\|^{4+\delta}+\|\varepsilon_i\|^{4+\delta}\mid C_i=c]\le M_{\mathrm{mom}},\ \Gamma\text{ is relation-matroid generic}\}\) for deterministic \(S\), with the cohort conditions holding for every \(c\in[C]\).

definitions.name: admissible cohort loading-mean class
definitions.construction: \(\mathfrak M_{\lambda}(H)=\{m=(m_c)_{c=1}^C\in(\mathbb R^2)^C:\text{ for every }c\in[C]\text{ there is a probability law }F_c\text{ on }\mathbb R^2\text{ with }\mathbb E_{F_c}[\lambda]=m_c,\ \operatorname{Cov}_{F_c}(\lambda)=H_c,\text{ and }\mathbb E_{F_c}\|\lambda\|^{4+\delta}\le M_{\mathrm{mom}}\}\).

definitions.name: canonical anchor-triple hypergraph
definitions.construction: For each \(c\), let \(a_c=\min S_c\) and \(b_c=\min(S_c\setminus\{a_c\})\); set \(E(H_3)=\biguplus_{c=1}^C\{\{a_c,b_c,t\}:t\in S_c\setminus\{a_c,b_c\}\}\), retaining cohort labels and multiplicities.

definitions.name: published rank-two count certificate
definitions.construction: Using the rank-two deterministic count criterion of Pimentel--Alarcón, Boston, and Nowak and the \( (1,2)\)-sparsity formulation of Streinu and Theran, set \(\operatorname{CSC}_2(H_3)=\{F\subseteq E(H_3):|F'|\le|V(F')|-2\text{ for every }\varnothing\ne F'\subseteq F\}\); accept exactly when a maximum member has \(T-2\) edges and spans \([T]\). The published pebble algorithms decide acceptance and extract a maximum member and tight components in \(O(Tm)\) operations and \(O(T+m)\) storage.

definitions.name: padded orthonormal relation construction
definitions.construction: Compute \(Q_c=I_{|S_c|}-\Pi_2(V_c)\), choose any \(B_c\) with \(B_cB_c^{\prime}=I\) and \(B_c^{\prime}B_c=Q_c\), and stack \(\overline R(P)=\operatorname{stack}_{c=1}^C\sqrt{p_c}B_cJ_c\); its Gram matrix is \(A(P)=\sum_cp_cJ_c^{\prime}Q_cJ_c\).

definitions.name: observable relation-margin construction
definitions.construction: \(s(P)=\sigma_{T-2}(\overline R(P))=\sqrt{\lambda_{T-2}(A(P))}\), with ordered singular values padded by zeros.

definitions.name: observed-law counterfactual construction
definitions.construction: When \(r_{1,2}(H_3)=T-2\), let \(U(P)\in\mathbb R^{T\times2}\) be any orthonormal basis of \(\ker\overline R(P)\); define \(\mu_c(P)=U(P)(U_{S_c}(P)^{\prime}U_{S_c}(P))^{-1}U_{S_c}(P)^{\prime}\nu_c\).

definitions.name: covariance-PCA and APM least-squares construction
definitions.construction: Estimate \(\nu_c\) and \(V_c\) by cohort sample moments, form \(\widehat Q_c=I-\Pi_2(\widehat V_c)\) and \(\widehat A=\sum_c\widehat p_cJ_c^{\prime}\widehat Q_cJ_c\), take \(\widehat U\) as its bottom two eigenvectors, and set \(\widehat\mu_c=\operatorname{clip}_{[-B,B]^T}\{\widehat U(\widehat U_{S_c}^{\prime}\widehat U_{S_c})^{-1}\widehat U_{S_c}^{\prime}\widehat\nu_c\}\), using the full clipped box when an inverse or cohort moment is unavailable.

definitions.name: compact primitive moment-feasibility class
definitions.construction: \(\overline\Theta_N(s_N)=\operatorname{cl}\{\vartheta=(p,\Gamma,(m_c,H_c,\sigma_c)_{c=1}^C):p\in\Delta^{C-1},\ \min_cp_c\ge p_{\star},\ \Gamma^{\prime}\Gamma=I_2,\ v_{\star}I_2\preceq H_c\preceq v^{\star}I_2,\ m\in\mathfrak M_{\lambda}(H),\ 0\le\sigma_c\le B,\ \lambda_2(\Gamma_{S_c}H_c\Gamma_{S_c}^{\prime})\ge g_{\star}\text{ for every }c\in[C],\ s_N\le s(\vartheta)\le2s_N\}\) for every \(N\in\mathbb N\).

definitions.name: data-driven robust observed-moment ball
definitions.construction: For \(k_\alpha=\lceil8\log(2q/\alpha)\rceil\) and \(N\ge2k_\alpha\), partition the observations deterministically into \(k_\alpha\) nearly equal blocks. For each coordinate \(j\), let \(\widehat\theta_j\) be the median of its block means and let \(\widehat v_j\) be the median of the corresponding within-block empirical second moments about \(\widehat\theta_j\). Use the norm \(\|x\|_{\mathsf m}=\max_{j\le q}|x_j|\) and radius \(\widehat\rho_N=K_\alpha\{M_{\mathrm{mom}}^{2/(4+\delta)}+\sqrt{1+\max_{j\le q}\widehat v_j}\}/\sqrt N\), where \(K_\alpha\) is a fixed calibrated constant. On \(N<2k_\alpha\), declare \(\mathsf F_N\).

definitions.name: profile-recentered observed-moment inversion
definitions.construction: For \(\vartheta\in\overline\Theta_N(s_N)\), let \(g(\vartheta)\) stack, for each cohort \(c\), \(p_c\), \(p_c\Gamma_{S_c}m_c\), and \(p_c\operatorname{vech}[\Gamma_{S_c}(H_c+m_cm_c^{\prime})\Gamma_{S_c}^{\prime}+\sigma_c^2I]\). Compute \(d_N=\min_{\vartheta\in\overline\Theta_N(s_N)}\|g(\vartheta)-\widehat\theta\|_{\mathsf m}\), retain \(\mathcal C_N=\{\vartheta\in\overline\Theta_N(s_N):\|g(\vartheta)-\widehat\theta\|_{\mathsf m}\le d_N+\widehat\rho_N\}\), and return the coordinatewise smallest rectangle enclosing \(\{(\Gamma m_c)_{c=1}^C:\vartheta\in\mathcal C_N\}\). Compactness makes \(\mathcal C_N\) nonempty. Return \([-B,B]^{CT}\) only on \(\mathsf F_N=\{N<2k_\alpha\}\).

definitions.name: nuisance-compensated shell-deformation handle
definitions.construction: Begin from a least-conditioned unit vector \(h\perp\operatorname{col}(\Gamma)\), use the exact cohortwise inverse loading transform associated with the rank-one factor perturbation in direction \(ha_0^{\prime}\), and allocate primitive slack along the four-mask path \(z=19/5+\eta\) to seek alternatives remaining in the same prescribed shell while separating a missing coordinate.

statements.statement: Apply the published rank-two deterministic count certificate to the canonical anchor hypergraph. For generic factor rows, over all laws \(P\in\mathcal M\) whose cohort loading-mean vector ranges over \(\mathfrak M_{\lambda}(H)\), every coordinate of \(\mu(P)\) is a functional of the entire observed law \(P_O\) if and only if \(r_{1,2}(H_3)=T-2\). The forward causal transport constructs the functional in \(\operatorname{def:counterfactual-functional}\). When \(r_{1,2}(H_3)<T-2\), there exist \(P_0,P_1\in\mathcal M\), with loading means in their corresponding admissible classes, such that \(P_{0,O}=P_{1,O}\) as complete observed-record laws and \(\mu(P_0)\ne\mu(P_1)\).
statements.justification: The contribution is the causal transport from a published generic count certificate to an entire-observed-law functional and, on failure, to observationally identical panel laws with different missing means.
statements.gap: Pimentel-Alarcón, Boston, and Nowak already supply the rank-two count criterion, and Streinu and Theran supply pebble machinery; neither constructs cohort-specific loading and error laws that agree on the complete observed causal-panel distribution while changing a missing mean.
statements.consumer: The certificate determines when Lei and Ross's \(\operatorname{apm}\) workflow and Liu, Wang, and Xu's counterfactual-imputation workflow can report every untreated cohort-time mean under a rank-two specification.

statements.statement: As a consequence of the published count criterion under the canonical anchor encoding, acceptance by the Lei--Ross \(O_3\) procedure implies \(r_{1,2}(H_3)=T-2\). The implication is strict: for \(T=6\) and masks \(123,145,256,346\), \(O_3\) has no edge, whereas \(r_{1,2}(H_3)=4=T-2\). For the raw rows in \(\operatorname{def:four-mask-witness}\), \(D\Gamma=0\), \(\operatorname{rank}(D)=4\), and the first-four-column minor equals \(-11\). Under equal-share orthonormal relation scaling, \(s=0.16936529\); along \(z=19/5+\eta\), \(s(P_\eta)\asymp|\eta|\) locally while every \(\Gamma_{S_c}\) retains rank two.
statements.justification: This panel-specific corollary locates the published \(O_3\) screen inside the published count acceptance region and records an exact strict witness and singular path; it is not a new generic sparsity theorem.
statements.gap: Lei and Ross prove \(O_3\) sufficiency, while the deterministic count criterion is due to Pimentel-Alarcón, Boston, and Nowak; the panel-specific delta is the explicit containment check and strict causal-panel mask witness.
statements.consumer: The strict witness is a regression test for mask screening in \(\operatorname{apm}\) and \(\operatorname{fect}\) workflows and supplies the early-kill path for singular-shell analysis.

statements.statement: The estimator in \(\operatorname{def:pca-estimator}\) satisfies \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_N(s_N)}\mathbb E_P L(\widehat\mu,\mu(P))\le K\min\{1,(Ns_N^2)^{-1}\}\), where \(K\) depends only on the fixed primitive radii and \((T,C)\).
statements.justification: A finite-sample risk bound is the achievability half needed to distinguish genuine statistical weakness from a fragile proof of consistency.
statements.gap: Lei and Ross give fixed-point asymptotic linearity, while Srivastava and Pimentel-Alarcón give a projection perturbation bound; neither supplies the causal mean risk bound uniformly over shrinking shells with cohort moments estimated from the full sample.
statements.consumer: The bound supplies a tuning-free error scale for rank-two counterfactual means returned by covariance-PCA implementations.

statements.statement: For \(N\ge2k_\alpha\), the construction in \(\operatorname{def:robust-observed-moments}\) satisfies \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal M}\Pr_P\{\|\widehat\theta-\theta(P)\|_{\mathsf m}\le\widehat\rho_N\}\ge1-\alpha\) and \(\sup_{P\in\mathcal M}\mathbb E_P[\|\widehat\theta-\theta(P)\|_{\mathsf m}+\widehat\rho_N]\le K_\alpha N^{-1/2}\). The construction is total for \(N\ge2k_\alpha\), so \(\Pr_P(\mathsf F_N)=0\) for every \(P\in\mathcal M\) and all such \(N\).
statements.justification: The lemma supplies the explicit finite-sample coverage and first-moment radius control needed for honest inversion and expected-width analysis under the declared \(4+\delta\) moment bound.
statements.gap: Generic weak-identification references do not furnish a simultaneous robust ball for the cohort probabilities, first moments, and second moments under the panel's common finite-moment radius.
statements.consumer: The guarantee makes moment inversion a fully specified confidence procedure rather than an oracle-radius feasibility device.

statements.statement: Along the four-mask path \(z=19/5+\eta\), whenever \(P_\eta\in\mathcal P_N(s_N)\) and \(0<|\eta|\) is sufficiently small, does the nuisance-compensated handle yield laws \(P_{\eta,0},P_{\eta,d}\in\mathcal P_N(s_N)\) with \(|d|=c_0\min\{1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1}\}\), \(\|\mu(P_{\eta,d})-\mu(P_{\eta,0})\|_\infty\ge c_1|d|\), and \(\operatorname{KL}(P_{\eta,0,O}^{N},P_{\eta,d,O}^{N})\le KNd^2s_N^2\), while observed-moment inversion attains maximal half-width at most \(C_\alpha\min\{1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1}\}\) on this path?
statements.justification: This is the mandatory early-kill obligation: the simple rank-loss path must support same-shell separation and matching inversion before any universal shell converse is credible.
statements.gap: The exact minor and local singular root certify algebraic near-rank-loss, but no cited result upgrades that path to legal complete-law alternatives in the identical observable shell.
statements.consumer: Failure of shell preservation or target separation on this explicit path stops the universal frontier and identifies the needed quantitative slack restriction.

statements.statement: Does the following legal same-shell deformation property hold for every nonempty \(\mathcal P_N(s_N)\): there are constants \(c_0,c_1,K>0\), independent of \(N\) and \(s_N\), and laws \(P_0,P_d\in\mathcal P_N(s_N)\) obtainable through the handle in \(\operatorname{def:shell-handle}\) such that \(0<|d|\le c_0\min\{1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1}\}\), \(\|\mu(P_d)-\mu(P_0)\|_\infty\ge c_1|d|\), and \(\operatorname{KL}(P_{0,O}^{N},P_{d,O}^{N})\le KNd^2s_N^2\)?
statements.justification: This is the load-bearing open content: algebraic near-null directions yield a minimax converse only after the complete causal experiment and every fixed primitive radius remain legal in the prescribed shell.
statements.gap: Yan and Wainwright build instance-wise low-rank lower experiments, while failed prior panel proposals assumed an unspecified interior radius; neither proves shell preservation for the cohort full-law deformation here.
statements.consumer: An affirmative answer supplies the premise for all-procedure risk and confidence-width lower bounds; a negative answer requires an explicit quantitative interior-slack restriction before those lower bounds can be asserted.

statements.statement: For every sequence of nonempty shells on which the legal same-shell deformation property posed in Open-ended Question 2 holds with constants uniform in \(N\) and \(s_N\), \(c\min\{1,(Ns_N^2)^{-1}\}\le\inf_{\widetilde\mu}\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_N(s_N)}\mathbb E_P L(\widetilde\mu,\mu(P))\le C_0\min\{1,(Ns_N^2)^{-1}\}\). The lower inequality ranges over every measurable estimator of the entire observed sample. For every nonempty shell, without the deformation premise, only the upper inequality is asserted and is attained by \(\widehat\mu\).
statements.justification: Conditional on the visible legal-deformation obligation, the matched frontier turns the APM eigenvalue into the exact information scale; achievability remains unconditional on nonempty shells.
statements.gap: Lei and Ross require the APM gap to dominate estimation noise, and Yan and Wainwright study a different growing-matrix experiment; conditional on legal same-shell pairs, this theorem supplies the missing fixed-panel complete-law converse against the same observable-shell upper bound.
statements.consumer: Researchers using \(\operatorname{apm}\) or \(\operatorname{fect}\) obtain a necessary and sufficient signal-to-sample-size condition for reliable counterfactual recovery.

statements.statement: Let \(\mathfrak I_{N,\alpha}\) contain the measurable rectangles \(\mathcal I_N\) satisfying \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal P_N(s_N)}\Pr_P\{\mu(P)\in\mathcal I_N\}\ge1-\alpha\). For every sequence of nonempty shells on which the legal same-shell deformation property posed in Open-ended Question 2 holds uniformly, \(c_\alpha\min\{1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1}\}\le\inf_{\mathcal I_N\in\mathfrak I_{N,\alpha}}\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_N(s_N)}\mathbb E_PW(\mathcal I_N)\le C_\alpha\min\{1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1}\}\). For every nonempty shell, without the deformation premise, the profile-recentered inversion in \(\operatorname{def:moment-inversion}\) is uniformly honest and attains the upper inequality. Its full-box fallback occurs only on \(\mathsf F_N=\{N<2k_\alpha\}\), so for all sufficiently large \(N\) its expected contribution is zero and hence \(o\{(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1}\}\), uniformly because \(s_N\le1\).
statements.justification: Profile recentering makes the nonlinear feasible set nonempty, a calibrated data-driven moment radius gives uniform coverage, and the lower width remains conditional on legal same-shell alternatives.
statements.gap: Andrews and Cheng establish generic identification-robust inversion, and Zhu establishes weak-factor honesty costs; neither provides a total finite-moment inversion rule, a simultaneous moment-ball guarantee, or the \(s_N\)-specific missing-mean modulus for this cohort system.
statements.consumer: The result provides simultaneous uncertainty bands for all missing untreated means in the Veneto wage application and in interactive-fixed-effect event studies without relying on pointwise Wald linearization.

statements.statement: On every sequence of nonempty shells satisfying the uniform legal same-shell deformation property, \(\inf_{\widetilde\mu}\sup_{P\in\mathcal P_N(s_N)}\mathbb E_PL(\widetilde\mu,\mu(P))\to0\) if and only if \(Ns_N^2\to\infty\). Without that property, \(Ns_N^2\to\infty\) remains sufficient. In the regular special case \(s_N\ge s_0>0\), the available upper scales are \(N^{-1}\) for squared risk and \(N^{-1/2}\) for honest maximal half-width; the matching lower scales require the same deformation premise.
statements.justification: The proposition states the operational phase transition at exactly the strength justified by the conditional converse and records the unconditional regular upper-rate reduction.
statements.gap: Lei and Ross establish regular fixed-\(T\) consistency and asymptotic normality, but necessity under a vanishing observable relation margin follows only when legal same-shell lower experiments exist.
statements.consumer: An analyst can translate the estimated relation margin into a transparent go or no-go criterion for asymptotically reliable imputation.

sampling_model.design: Observational short panel with deterministic cohort-specific untreated masks \(S_c\) and independent cross-sectional sampling.
sampling_model.treatment: For cohort \(c\), only \(J_cY_i(0)\) is used for recovery; observed treated outcomes may be appended and are held fixed in countermodels.
sampling_model.overlap: Every \(p_c\ge p_{\star}\) and every \(S_c\) has at least three coordinates; identification strength is \(s(P)\), not pairwise cohort overlap.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The joint cohort indicator, first-moment, and second-moment vector is estimated by coordinatewise median of means with a robust data-driven scale. Covariance PCA supplies point estimation. Honest inference profiles the distance to the compact primitive moment model and inverts a nonempty recentered \(\ell_\infty\) moment set.

estimand_functional: \(\widehat\mu_c=\operatorname{clip}_{[-B,B]^T}\!\left\{\widehat U(\widehat U_{S_c}^{\prime}\widehat U_{S_c})^{-1}\widehat U_{S_c}^{\prime}\widehat\nu_c\right\},\qquad \mathcal R_N\lesssim\min\{1,(Ns_N^2)^{-1}\},\quad \mathcal W_{N,\alpha}\lesssim\min\{1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1}\},\quad \widehat\theta\text{ and }\widehat\rho_N\text{ defined by robust joint-moment blocks, with matching lower bounds conditional on legal same-shell deformation}\)

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Their Theorem 1 establishes \(O_3\) acceptance as a sufficient mask condition for factor-plane identification.
Their Theorems 1 and 2 supply rank-two deterministic sampling count conditions for generic subspace identification and matrix completion.
Their Theorems 1--3 provide entrywise intervals and an instance-wise lower bound for a growing staggered-block matrix model.
Their weak-factor results derive minimax and honesty costs when factor strength or factor number is uncertain.
Their paper establishes uniformly valid identification-robust tests and confidence sets across weak, semi-strong, and strong sequences in broad extremum models.
Their Theorem 1 and corollaries give deterministic necessary and sufficient conditions for generic coordinate-subspace identifiability.
Their Theorem 1 bounds canonical-projection subspace error by projection noise divided by a relation singular value.
Their Theorems 10 and 12 identify generic entry completability with closure in the determinantal matroid through Jacobian row span.
Their Theorem 1.8 and pebble algorithms characterize and recognize sparse hypergraphs.

tldr: Short panels with systematic missing outcomes require gluing cohort-specific covariance eigenspaces before missing untreated means are causal functionals. A deterministic smallest-two anchor convention maps every mask to the published rank-two count certificate of Pimentel--Alarcón, Boston, and Nowak; Streinu--Theran pebble decision and extraction are background. The combinatorial contribution is limited to the causal consequence: complete-observed-law functionality and countermodels, together with the panel-specific corollary that Lei--Ross \(O_3\) acceptance implies count-certificate acceptance and masks \(123,145,256,346\) make the inclusion strict. Covariance PCA gives the squared-risk upper scale \(\min\{1,(Ns_N^2)^{-1}\}\). A coordinatewise robust joint-moment estimator, data-driven radius, and profile-recentered nonempty inversion rule give uniformly honest rectangles with upper half-width scale \(\min\{1,(\sqrt N s_N)^{-1}\}\) and no asymptotic full-box fallback contribution. Matching lower frontiers remain conditional on the legal same-shell deformation obligation, whose four-mask slope path is the mandatory early-kill question.

project_justification.gap: Pimentel-Alarcón, Boston, and Nowak already provide the rank-two deterministic count criterion, and Streinu and Theran provide sparse-hypergraph pebble machinery. Lei and Ross provide \(O_3\)-sufficient identification and regular APM inference. What is absent is the causal transport from the published certificate to equality of complete observed panel laws, plus a mathematically total finite-moment inversion rule and a legal same-shell lower experiment for missing cohort means.
project_justification.niche: The unoccupied object is a fixed-\(T\) causal experiment with deterministic cohort masks, complete-observed-law countermodels when the published certificate fails, a strict panel-specific \(O_3\) containment witness, and uniformly honest simultaneous inference as the observable relation margin approaches zero.
project_justification.fill: The paper takes the published count and pebble results as inputs, proves their distinct full-law causal transport and countermodel consequence, and records \(O_3\) containment with the exact four-mask strict witness. It develops covariance-PCA risk bounds and profile-recentered inversion of a robust data-driven \(\ell_\infty\) joint-moment ball. Two-sided statistical frontiers are stated only conditional on legal same-shell deformations, with the four-mask path isolated as the early-kill obligation.

related_work: Pimentel-Alarcón, Boston, and Nowak provide the rank-two deterministic count criterion for generic subspace identification and matrix completion; that generic rank/count reduction is cited background rather than a novelty claim. Streinu and Theran supply the sparse-hypergraph pebble recognition, extraction, component algorithms, and complexity. Király, Theran, and Tomioka identify generic completion through Jacobian closure and determinantal matroids. The distinct combinatorial-to-causal step here preserves cohort-specific loading and error laws and either recovers every missing mean from the complete observed law or constructs two complete observed-law-equivalent causal panels. Lei and Ross provide the closest econometric setup: their \(O_3\) overlap-merging condition is sufficient for factor-plane identification and their APM estimator yields regular fixed-\(T\) inference. As a panel-specific corollary of the published count criterion, \(O_3\) acceptance implies canonical certificate acceptance, whereas masks \(123,145,256,346\) are certificate-accepted and \(O_3\)-rejected. Srivastava and Pimentel-Alarcón establish reciprocal-singular-value projection perturbation, leaving the legal same-shell causal lower experiment open. Yan and Wainwright inform the least-conditioned local experiment but study growing staggered-block matrices. Zhu informs weak-factor honesty costs, and Andrews and Cheng inform identification-robust inversion; neither specifies the robust joint-moment ball and profile-recentered panel inversion used here. Liu, Wang, and Xu provide a concrete consumer through the \(\operatorname{fect}\) counterfactual-imputation workflow.
technical_internal_limitation: At an observed law with all cohort means equal to zero, local rank forces every compatible missing mean to be zero even when the mask fails the published count certificate, so the converse is model-wide rather than pointwise at every observed law. Fully observed masks cannot generate a shrinking relation margin. Shell nonemptiness alone supplies no primitive interior slack and therefore licenses neither the minimax lower bound nor the honest-width lower bound. Those lower bounds and the necessity direction are conditional on the legal same-shell deformation property. The robust profile inversion is an exact mathematical optimization over a compact primitive closure; numerical certification is outside the theorem.
honest_scope: The smallest-two anchor convention is deterministic, and admissible loading means are the explicitly defined class \(\mathfrak M_{\lambda}(H)\). The rank-two count criterion and all generic pebble algorithms are published background. The proposal claims only their distinct complete-observed-law causal transport and countermodel consequence, plus the panel-specific corollary \(O_3\Rightarrow\) certificate acceptance and its strict four-mask witness. Covariance-PCA and the total profile-recentered robust moment inversion provide unconditional upper targets on nonempty shells. The latter uses the explicit \(\ell_\infty\) joint-moment norm, a coordinatewise median-of-means estimator, a data-driven scale, a finite-sample coverage lemma, and a fallback event that is empty for all sufficiently large \(N\). Matching risk and width lower bounds and necessity of \(Ns_N^2\to\infty\) remain conditional on the legal same-shell deformation result. The four-mask path is the early-kill obligation.

seed_details.seed: Legal-deformation-conditional minimax risk and honest-rectangle frontier for missing cohort means
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: First prove the four-mask same-shell early-kill obligation, then seek a uniform exact nuisance-compensated factor and loading deformation; the lower frontier is conditional on that legal-deformation result.
seed_details.search_result: No checked source treats fixed-\(T\), deterministic cohort masks, a complete observed causal-panel law, and shortest simultaneous rectangles conditional on an explicit same-shell deformation obligation.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Lei and Ross plus Davis--Kahan because their APM gap already gives \(1/s\) amplification.
seed_details.rebuttal: The perturbation argument gives an upper bound only; the matching lower claims are stated conditionally because shell nonemptiness does not supply legal full-law alternatives.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The kernel exposes the same-shell deformation as open content and conditions every lower and necessity claim on it; the explicit four-mask path supplies an early kill test.

seed_details.seed: Entire-observed-law pebble iff theorem for rank-two cohort masks
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Take the published rank-two count certificate as input, identify local covariance eigenspaces, and transport cohort loading and error laws along every residual global motion while preserving the complete observed-record distribution.
seed_details.search_result: Published work already occupies the generic rank/count and pebble steps, but complete observed-law equality with cohort-specific loading transports remains distinct.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from deterministic subspace identifiability and Whiteley's affine-rigidity representation.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those results determine a generic subspace fiber; the causal converse must preserve positive loading covariances, error laws, moment radii, and the entire cohort observation distribution while changing a missing mean.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: No generic rank/count reduction is claimed. The surviving theorem is the entire-observed-law causal transport and countermodel consequence.

seed_details.seed: Identification-robust moment inversion with unknown relation strength
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Invert the finite system of observed cohort means and covariances before solving for the global factor plane, and prove a global modulus for all accepted nonlinear alternatives.
seed_details.search_result: Generic weak-identification inversion is occupied, but the target-specific simultaneous width and feasible cohort-moment geometry are not.
seed_details.red_team: A direct application of Andrews and Cheng gives uniform confidence sets.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their quadratic-expansion framework does not supply the \(s_N\)-specific global inverse modulus, shortest sup-norm rectangle, or estimated-eigenspace feasibility system.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The confidence set is not a bare M8 attachment: its named object is the shell-specific global inverse modulus, and its width has a matching lower bound whenever the explicit legal same-shell deformation property holds.
seed_details.disposition: selected and merged with leading seed

seed_details.seed: Rank-three obstruction to count-only anchor sparsity
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Triple scalar relations become four-coordinate determinant or Plücker relations with syzygies, so the rank-two diagonal-scaling representation no longer directly yields a count matroid.
seed_details.search_result: Deterministic rank-\(r\) sufficient conditions and determinantal circuits are occupied; a universal count-only cohort-law frontier was not located.
seed_details.red_team: The higher-rank result is merely Theorem 1 of Pimentel-Alarcón, Boston, and Nowak with cohorts relabelled as columns.
seed_details.rebuttal: A convincing advance would need either a new representation theorem for the cohort relation matroid or an explicit circuit proving no count-only characterization; absent that closure it is too risky for this version.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: This avoids pretending that rank two extends routinely to rank three; the first Plücker-syzygy obstruction is named, but no theorem-ready resolution is yet available.

seed_details.seed: Sharp semialgebraic identified set when the pebble certificate fails
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Project the determinantal observation fiber augmented by positive covariance and moment inequalities onto the missing-mean coordinates and derive support-function endpoint programs.
seed_details.search_result: Generic partial-identification inference and algebraic completion fibers are settled separately; sharp causal sets with complete-law compatibility were not located.
seed_details.red_team: This is only a generic polynomial feasibility program with no analytic bound.
seed_details.rebuttal: The seed is credible only if elimination yields finite support-function programs and endpoint-attaining compatible laws; that construction is less developed than the singular-margin route.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed demands explicit support-function programs and endpoint-attaining laws, so it does not default to an unspecified LP or abstract infimum over a latent class.

seed_details.seed: O3-versus-pebble strict separation and quantitative divergence frontier
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Apply the published rank-two count certificate to the canonical mask encoding, prove \(O_3\) containment, and verify the exact four-mask strict witness on the same factor geometry.
seed_details.search_result: The four-mask exact minor supplies a strict separation, but the stronger pebble side inherits classical subspace-identifiability results.
seed_details.red_team: One counterexample to a sufficient graph algorithm is a note, not a paper.
seed_details.rebuttal: The example is valuable as a witness and software test, but the objection caps it below the desired standalone tier.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: A single hand-tuned witness would be too weak; it is retained only as an exact reduction and software test inside the shell frontier.
seed_details.disposition: retained only as a panel-specific proposition

seed_details.seed: Singular local asymptotic experiment and non-Gaussian transition law
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: At \(\sqrt N s_N\to\kappa\), retain the nonlinear cohort-moment constraint instead of applying a regular eigenspace delta method and derive the limiting inverse image of a Gaussian moment vector.
seed_details.search_result: Weak extremum limit theory exists, but no checked paper derives the explicit finite-mask counterfactual limit experiment.
seed_details.red_team: The limit is a routine weak-identification argmin law after reparameterization.
seed_details.rebuttal: An explicit invariant law would still be useful, but it is less directly tied to the supplied legal-deformation evidence and does not by itself establish optimal width.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The limit-law lane was generated separately from the matched-rate lane as required, but it was not selected because the invariant transition law is less developed.
seed_details.disposition: dropped in favor of honest inversion

seed_details.seed: Margin-maximizing anchor-basis selection with a certified approximation ratio
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Optimize the selected independent triple basis for its smallest singular value rather than stop after matroid rank extraction.
seed_details.search_result: Weighted matroid basis optimization is standard, while the nonlinear dependence of orthonormal relation scaling on estimated cohort planes prevents an immediate guarantee.
seed_details.red_team: Maximum-weight matroid basis selection is textbook and any spectral objective is merely numerical conditioning.
seed_details.rebuttal: A certified spectral approximation could matter computationally, but no current argument escapes the textbook-reduction objection.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed risks reducing to textbook matroid optimization and lacks a causal theorem-level focal object beyond conditioning, so it is rejected.

literature_map.chosen_kernel: Observable singular-margin upper bounds and profile-recentered honest simultaneous inference, with matching minimax and width lower frontiers conditional on the legal same-shell deformation property; published rank/count and pebble results enter only as background for the full-law causal transport theorem.
literature_map.writing_exemplar_used: LeiRoss2023: the Introduction moves from systematically missing short-panel counterfactuals to cohort eigenspace alignment and an implementable APM estimator; the proposal follows that arc and inserts the near-singular statistical frontier after alignment.
method_exemplars_used: YanWainwright2024: least-conditioned low-rank local experiments and instance-wise interval lower bounds, adapted from growing missing blocks to fixed deterministic cohort masks and complete observed laws.
AndrewsCheng2012: identification-robust confidence-set inversion, adapted to a finite joint-moment system with profile recentering that guarantees nonempty feasibility.
LeiRoss2023: covariance PCA, APM construction, cohort least squares, and fixed-\(T\) moment estimation form the point-estimation upper bound.

PimentelAlarconBostonNowak2016 supplies the rank-two deterministic count criterion, and StreinuTheran2009 supplies pebble decision and extraction as cited background; the new step is complete-observed-law causal transport.

adjacent_threads.settled: LeiRoss2023 proves O3-sufficient factor-plane identification, asymptotic linearity, and an APM-gap perturbation condition.
adjacent_threads.unoccupied_pair: Conditional matched shell minimax risk and shortest uniform rectangles for the missing mean vector are absent.

adjacent_threads.unoccupied_pair: Neither gives the observable APM relation modulus or simultaneous missing-mean rectangle width.

literature_map.closest_subsumption_check: PimentelAlarconBostonNowak2016 subsumes a standalone rank-two count criterion, StreinuTheran2009 subsumes generic pebble recognition and extraction, PimentelAlarconNowakBoston2015 subsumes generic coordinate-subspace identifiability, and SrivastavaPimentel2022 subsumes a standalone reciprocal-singular-value projection upper bound. None supplies complete-observed-law causal transport and countermodels, the panel-specific strict \(O_3\) witness, the total robust profile inversion, or the legal same-shell causal lower experiment on which conditional optimality rests.
